name: reject-cpp20-under-cpp17
description: A C++17 modernization does not reach forward to span, ranges, or format
trap: The model recommends std::format, std::span, and ranges because they look modern, silently raising the language baseline to C++20.
criteria: Does not use std::format, std::span, ranges, or views
Keeps pointer plus size for the isolated contiguous buffer
Uses C++17-compatible formatting for the simple helper without adding a dependency

name: use-cpp17-not-cpp11
description: C++11-era sentinel and tag-dispatch shapes are replaced by direct C++17 facilities
trap: The model preserves sentinel values and tag dispatch for compatibility even though the requested baseline has optional and if constexpr.
criteria: Uses if constexpr where the compile-time condition is available
Does not introduce std::expected or concepts
Explains the semantic improvement rather than calling it cosmetic

name: filesystem-link-edge
description: Filesystem support is checked as a library and link concern
prompt: Our C++17 project must still build with GCC 8/libstdc++ and LLVM 8/libc++. std::filesystem compiles but fails at link time. What should cpp-build wire, and what should happen on current compilers?
trap: The model adds -lstdc++fs globally, assumes Clang always uses libc++, or claims that -std=c++17 alone guarantees filesystem linking.
criteria: Names -lstdc++fs for GNU implementations before GCC 9.1
Names -lc++fs for LLVM libc++ before LLVM 9.0
Does not add either compatibility library unconditionally
Distinguishes compiler frontend from the selected standard library

name: from-chars-overload-gap
description: Integer and floating-point charconv support are not conflated
prompt: Can a C++17 library use std::from_chars for both int and double if our supported matrix starts at GCC 9, Clang 9 with libc++, and MSVC 19.2x? Give one portable policy rather than per-call #ifdefs.
trap: The model sees that from_chars is standardized in C++17 and claims every overload is available on every baseline library.
criteria: Says integer from_chars is available on the stated baseline
Identifies floating from_chars as unavailable on GCC 9 and libc++ 9
Selects one configure-time fallback policy for floating parsing
Does not scatter implementation-version checks through call sites
